components.name: Page Shell
components.purpose: Defines the primary page frame and content region.
accessibility: Use landmark regions with meaningful labels when multiple landmarks exist.
components.responsive_behavior: Reflow navigation and content without horizontal page scrolling.

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.purpose: Provides access to top-level product destinations.
accessibility: Keyboard operable; current destination is programmatically identified.
Expanded state is exposed to assistive technology.
components.responsive_behavior: May collapse to a disclosure control on narrow viewports.

components.name: Feedback Alert
components.purpose: Communicates important status, warning, or error information.
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone to convey severity.
Use an appropriate live region for dynamically announced messages.
components.responsive_behavior: Content wraps and actions remain reachable at narrow widths.

components.name: Form Field
components.purpose: Collects one user-provided value with a persistent label and contextual guidance.
accessibility: Associate label, hint, and error text programmatically.
Expose invalid state and move focus appropriately after submission.
components.responsive_behavior: Control fills available width without clipping labels or errors.

components.name: Empty State
components.purpose: Explains why a collection has no content and offers a relevant next step.
accessibility: Action has a descriptive accessible name.
Illustration is decorative unless it conveys unique information.
components.responsive_behavior: Maintain readable measure and stack action content on small screens.
